310-952-1720 prior to the meeting.” (Government Code Section 54954.2)
**ORAL COMMUNICATIONS**
The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council ,
other than closed session matters, prior to any action taken on the agenda.
Because of the threat of COVID-19 (aka the “Coronavirus”) you are urged to take
all appropriate health safety precautions.

DUE TO CORONAVIRUS COVID-19, NO MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE
ALLOWED INTO THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS DURING CARSON COUNCIL
MEETINGS.

TO FACILITATE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION  OUR  CARSON  CITY  COUNCIL
MEETINGS WILL BE AVAILABLE TO YOU BY:

• Livestream on the City’s website:  The meeting will be conducted live over the
internet via http://ci.carson.ca.us

•  Cable Channel 35 (Spectrum) and Channel 99 (AT&T)

Any members of the public wishing to provide public comment for the items on the
agenda may do so as follows:
1. Email:  You can email comments to cityclerk@carson.ca.us  or through the
home page of our city’s website at ci.carson.ca.us, up until the meeting’s

  Recommendation:  TAKE the following actions:

  1. DISCUSS and provide direction to staff on the draft reopening
  plan for Carson City Hall, provide input on the reopening of other
  City facilities including parks and recreation facilities, and on the
  outreach and public information efforts to provide information to
  local businesses about their opportunities to reopen under the
  current State guidelines.

  2. DISCUSS and provide direction to staff on other activities
  outside City facilities that may have been or may be impacted by
  continued social distancing orders, such as Block Party permits for
  July 4th, street sweeping, and other code enforcement activities.

2.. CONSIDER DIRECTION TO STAFF TO PREPARE A REOPENING PLAN FOR CITY HALL AND OTHER CITY FACILITIES, AND DIRECTION TO STAFF ON JULY 4 BLOCK PARTY PERMITS AND OTHER OUTSIDE ACTIVITIES (CITY COUNCIL)  -  Action: adopted (Pass) Moved by Cedric Hicks CM gave a brief staff report. 

ACM Raymond gave a power point presentation on City Hall reopening. 

ACM Roberts gave a power point presentation on reopening city park and recreation services. CC LDH inquired which parks and programs will be reopened. 

ACM Roberts answered her inquiry - Parks with Gyms

JD inquired about what equipment staff is referring too that they do not currently have. 

Hicks - recommended city council approve a motion to open up all city parks. In addition, he gave a recommendation on a plan of action for staff to take to parks including open by June 29th. 

Mike Whittaker gave a presentation on reopening the city's parks and programs in phases. Discussion ensued about the process of reopening the parks.

MPTJD recommended CC give direction to CM to bring back all city employees.  

Bring staff back by June 22 and all open June 29th - Re open all city parks. 

JH inquired if play in the park is allowed - Staff addressed his inquiry. 

ACM Raymond gave a presentation on reopening outside city facilities. 

Discussion ensued about whether or not 

LDH moved to approve allowing street closures and block party permits, seconded by Hilton during discussion on the motion: 

Wear face mask - recommend no shared food or close contact activities (bounce house) - providing recommendations including safe and sane when issuing permits. 

JD moved to immediately bring back all city employees back to work, seconded by Hilton 

CM asked the maker of the motion to include subject to a meet and confer. 
CAO Soltani clarified to add subject to completion of a meet and confer. 

Discussion ensued about how to move forward. 
LDH requested CM 

Bring everybody back immediately - anyone with job curtailments (staff bring them back or need to be reployed) subjected to meet and confer within 6 days.
